title: use brew removes the link when Homebrew's devbin is on PATH but will not run, and brew_answer_state infers offpath rather than checking it
body:
`brew_answer_state` takes bash's own search for the copy that would answer `devbin` once the link is gone, and bash's search, finding no executable `devbin`, returns one that is not executable rather than none. So with the keg's launcher lacking its execute bit and Homebrew's bin on PATH, the answer is `brew`, `use brew` removes the link, and the `devbin` left on PATH fails with "Permission denied": no devbin answers, the outcome T5's amendment A4 exists to prevent. And when the search finds nothing, `brew_answer_state` answers `offpath` whenever Homebrew's bin link leads into the keg, without asking whether Homebrew's bin was among the entries it searched, so its refusal can say Homebrew's bin is not on PATH when it is, and give putting it there as the remedy; the route measured there is the colon splitter's newline cut-off, filed beside this. cc's critic-shell review of 0235 raised the `offpath` inference, and gave a launcher without its execute bit as its route; measured on main, that route answers `brew`, not `offpath`.

## Cause

Measured on main at 15f2a973 under bash 5.3.20.

- `lib/helpers:3866`: the search is `type -P devbin` over the entries kept. bash 5.3.20, measured: with only a non-executable `devbin` on PATH, `type -P` prints it and returns 0; with an executable one later on PATH, it prints the executable one.
- `lib/helpers:3868-3875`: a hit is resolved and compared with the keg's `bin/devbin`; nothing asks whether it would run.
- `lib/helpers:3877-3883`: with no hit, the answer is `offpath` when Homebrew's bin link resolves to the keg's `bin/devbin`; nothing reads whether that bin is among the entries searched.
- `lib/cmd/use:194-199`: `brew` removes the link. `lib/cmd/use:131-134`: the `offpath` refusal says Homebrew's bin is not on PATH and gives putting it there as the remedy.
- The probe (`~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/174/probe-0235-followups.sh`, which sources main's `lib/helpers` against a fixture and runs no bats): with the keg's launcher made non-executable and Homebrew's bin on PATH after the link, `brew_answer_state` answers `brew <prefix>/opt/devbin/libexec`, and `devbin` run through Homebrew's bin fails with "Permission denied", rc 126.

## Fix

A hit counts only when the file it resolves to would run. When Homebrew's bin is among the entries searched and its devbin will not run, `brew_answer_state` answers a state of its own naming that file, and `use brew` refuses, removing nothing, with reinstalling devbin with Homebrew as the remedy. `offpath` is answered only when Homebrew's bin is not among the entries searched, each read in `physical_dir`'s `getcwd` mode.

## Done when

1. With the keg's launcher not executable and Homebrew's bin on PATH, `use brew` refuses with a non-zero exit, names the file that would not run and the remedy, and leaves the link exactly as it was. An arm, red on main where the link is removed, and green at the fix.
2. With a linked keg and Homebrew's bin off PATH, `use brew` still refuses with `offpath`'s reason and remedy, as use.bats's arm for it holds.
3. use.bats passes at the fix under BSD and GNU, beside the tree scans and help.
4. CI's run on the pushed head is green on Test on Ubuntu.

## Deferred to 0.1.17

hv deferred this to devbin 0.1.17 on 2026-10-28 ("defer E to 0.1.17, close 0274 and 0278", relayed verbatim by molt-vc at 18:11Z by date -u). It was built in cc's stage 8 bank for 0.1.16 (s8-rebuild adc44833 in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/s8/s8a/build, on dc's e3c9c8bb), which had not finished its checks or run. It is not started for 0.1.17: the bank is kept as a starting point and is rebuilt on 0.1.17's base, then checked, run and reviewed as new.

## Resolution

- use brew counts a devbin on PATH only when it would run (path_hit asks -x of the hit), refuses naming Homebrew's devbin that is not executable, the keg's env script or the libexec launcher it runs (brew_launcher_inert), and answers offpath only when Homebrew's bin is not among the entries searched (path_searches). A bin link that reaches the keg only through the link is vialink, with brew link --overwrite as its remedy.
- Landed on main: `f3aaee76`.
- Arms: use.bats, use brew with Homebrew's devbin not executable; with the env script executable and the libexec launcher it runs not; with Homebrew's bin link reaching the keg only through the link.
- Desk evidence: hv's full run 20261029-1314, 2826 counted, ran every arm above ok.
- Run 20261029-1336 (`--failed`) ran that run's two reds, neither in this issue's arms, ok at their fixes, 2 of 2, so main at 5085ae24 is green.
